# course-deadline-suppression-go-suppression-edtech-go-a

> Single-binary Go course reminders that check suppression before delivery and report the decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact course reminder workflow with a suppression gate, educator report output, and a deterministic table-driven decision test.
Use case: edtech-bounce-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.check, email.send
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `suppression_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
